title: Kimball, Jimmy Brown and Ransom as bassists
summary: He answers about Kimball and praises Jimmy Brown, then Ransom, as fine bass players.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Remember Mr. Kimball. Did you hear him?

Remember Kimball? Oh, you mean Kimball's daddy? No, I don't remember him. I don't remember Kimball. Kimball was never a fine bass player. He was converted from guitar to bass. He did a fine job. He still playing nice bass. Who? Jimmy Brown. Jimmy Brown. Brown Uptown? Still playing? Brown from downtown. He was the best down there then. Jimmy Brown.
He played imperial all the time. I don't remember him.
This fellow, he's broke up out here to play a rubber show, Ransom. He's a wonderful bass player. Yeah, that Ransom. Yeah, I knew him.
